statement_download.label: Statement download
statement_download.text: Steps: 1. Go to your profile. 2. Select the 'Reports' option. 3. Under 'Tax', find 'Mutual Fund - ELSS statement'. 4. Click on 'Download'.

sections.heading: What is a mutual funds ELSS report?
sections.name: answer
paragraphs: The ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) report shows your purchases in ELSS mutual funds and the total amount you invested in the selected financial year.
